design_description: The FC Grinta kit uses a powerful golden yellow and black identity, built around energy, aggression and a strong connection to the team's home. The front is divided dynamically through diagonal distressed brush strokes, transitioning from a dominant yellow upper-left section into black across the right side and lower body. A large roaring lion emerges from this transition behind the bold FC GRINTA wordmark, creating the main visual focal point. At the bottom, an illustrated local cityscape, bridge, mountains and waterfront reflection anchors the design geographically and gives the shirt a much more personal identity. The club crest continues the same black-and-gold language, while the black collar and striped cuffs sharpen the overall finish. The back simplifies the concept, retaining the diagonal black-and-yellow brush treatment while leaving a cleaner central area for the large white player name and number. Matching shorts use the same distressed brush graphics, completing the kit as a coherent unit. Overall, it is a bold, territorial and highly expressive FC Grinta design: the lion communicates strength and grinta, while the cityscape represents where the team comes from, all unified through an aggressive black-and-gold visual language.
